notes:
A Chinese-origin dish popular in Japan, consisting of deep-fried pork pieces coated in a sweet and sour sauce with vegetables. Composed of ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar) and ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧ (pork). It is one of the most recognized dishes in Japanese-style Chinese cuisine (⟦{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}→中華料理：18122_chuukaryouri⟧).

- {酢豚|すぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: make sweet and sour pork

CULTURAL NOTE:
Whether pineapple belongs in {酢豚|すぶた} is a famously divisive topic in Japan, similar to the pineapple-on-pizza debate in Western countries. The original Cantonese dish ({咕咾肉|グーラオロウ}) typically includes pineapple.
